research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The title Method and system for capturing and storing significant surveillance images and its abstract describe a system with multiple infrared light sources at different wavelengths to enhance image capture. It filters and stores only significant surveillance images, focusing on efficient storage and retrieval of relevant visual data. Flock Safety is researching and developing multi wavelength infrared imaging and selective image storage for improved surveillance capabilities.

overview_description.description: Flock Safety develops security solutions using automated license plate recognition cameras. Its main product is its ALPR cameras, which are used by neighborhoods, law enforcement agencies, and businesses to capture and analyze vehicle license plates. These cameras help in solving and preventing crimes by providing actionable data. The company's platform combines the power of communities at scale, including cities, businesses, schools, and law enforcement agencies – to shape a safer future together. Their full-service, maintenance-free technology solution is trusted by communities to help solve and deter crime in the pursuit of safer communities for everyone.

about_short_description.short_description: Flock Safety provides end-to-end surveillance solutions to support law enforcement and communities.

product.name: License Plate Readers (LPR)
product.description: Cameras that capture vehicle evidence, including time, location, and vehicle characteristics, for searchable investigations and real-time alerts.

product.name: Flock Safety Platform
product.description: A connected platform that combines camera, sensor, vehicle, and investigation data to support evidence review and incident response.

product.name: Video Cameras
product.description: Cloud-connected security cameras that provide searchable scene video, AI-powered alerts, and shared incident context.

product.name: Drone as First Responder
product.description: A remotely launched, CAD-integrated drone service that provides live aerial video before responders arrive at an incident.

product.name: Mobile Security Trailers
product.description: Rapid-deployment security trailers that provide temporary camera coverage, automated monitoring, deterrence, and real-time intervention.

product.name: Audio Detection
product.description: A sensor-based event detection system that identifies critical sounds and connects detected events with visual evidence.
